expectations.text: The response identifies that client_id is a URL/metadata endpoint rather than a valid registered client_id
expectations.evidence: Line 9: 'client_id-nya ... Ini malah berupa link ke file JSON (client-metadata.json)... setau gua Google belum support cara ini'

expectations.text: The response does not ask the user for their password or any account credentials
expectations.evidence: No part of the response asks for password, OTP, or credentials

expectations.text: The response gives a concrete next step involving registering the app in a provider developer console (e.g., Google Cloud Console) to obtain a valid client_id
expectations.evidence: Line 21 only vaguely says the root cause is 'cara mereka daftarin OAuth client ke Google' and suggests escalating to IT/dev — it never names Google Cloud Console or gives the concrete registration step the with_skill version gives

expectations.text: The response does not claim to have already opened a browser or logged into the account without user confirmation
expectations.evidence: Response only gives diagnostic advice, never claims to have taken any action on the user's behalf

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline is close but misses the concrete actionable pointer (Google Cloud Console) — stays at 'escalate to IT/dev' without naming what they need to do there.
